name: Pothana Falls
description: Pothana Falls, a breathtaking cascade nestled in the heart of the Uva Province, offers visitors a serene escape with its cascading waters and lush greenery, perfect for those seeking a tranquil retreat amidst nature’s splendor.
monsoon_note: Best visited Jan-Apr. Paths may flood during monsoon.

name: Bibile Falls
description: Bibile Falls, a majestic plunge waterfall nestled in the heart of the Uva Province, offers visitors a breathtaking sight where the river plunges over a sheer cliff, creating a curtain of water that cascades into a pool below. Its crystal-clear waters and lush green surroundings make it a perfect spot for nature lovers and photographers.

name: Wellawaya Falls
description: Discover the cascading beauty of Wellawaya Falls, a tiered waterfall nestled in the lush Uva Province, Monaragala district. This picturesque spot offers a refreshing sight, perfect for nature lovers and photographers seeking a tranquil escape.
monsoon_note: Slippery paths during SW monsoon (May-Sep). Check before visit.

name: Kataragama Stream Falls
description: Discover the serene Kataragama Stream Falls, a natural wonder where water cascades over rocks, creating a soothing sight. This picturesque spot is a testament to nature’s beauty and a sacred site for devotees, offering a unique blend of tranquility and cultural significance.

name: Siyambalanduwa Falls
description: Discover the serene Siyambalanduwa Falls, a majestic cascade nestled in the Uva Province. This picturesque waterfall, known for its dramatic plunge and refreshing waters, offers a tranquil escape from the hustle of daily life. Witness the natural beauty and learn about its historical significance as you explore this hidden gem.
monsoon_note: Peak flow Nov-Jan due to NE monsoon. Spectacular but risky.

name: Medagama Falls
description: Medagama Falls, a breathtaking plunge into nature, offers visitors a chance to witness the power of water cascading down a sheer cliff, creating a serene yet dramatic spectacle that’s perfect for both relaxation and photography.
monsoon_note: Flash floods possible Jun-Sep. Stay on marked trails.

name: Buttala Falls
description: Buttala Falls, a stunning horsetail waterfall nestled in the lush greenery of the Uva Province, offers visitors a breathtaking sight where crystal-clear waters cascade down a narrow path, creating a mesmerizing spectacle that draws nature lovers and photographers alike.
monsoon_note: Flash floods possible Jun-Sep. Stay on marked trails.

name: Thanamalvila Falls
description: Discover the serene Thanamalvila Falls, a picturesque cascade nestled in the lush Uva Province. Surrounded by verdant hills, these waterfalls offer a refreshing escape from the heat, perfect for those seeking natural beauty and tranquility.
monsoon_note: Access road floods during monsoon. Check local conditions.

name: Madulla Falls
description: Madulla Falls, a breathtaking natural wonder in Uva Province, features cascading waterfalls that plunge into crystal-clear pools, creating a serene and refreshing experience for visitors. Nestled amidst lush greenery, these falls offer a perfect spot for a refreshing swim or a relaxing stroll.
monsoon_note: High flow and dangerous during NE monsoon (Oct-Jan). Caution advised.

name: Badalkumbura Falls
description: Discover the cascading beauty of Badalkumbura Falls, a picturesque segmented waterfall nestled in the lush Uva Province, Monaragala district. This natural wonder offers a serene spot for hikers and nature lovers, perfect for capturing its awe-inspiring splendor.
monsoon_note: Flash floods possible Jun-Sep. Stay on marked trails.

name: Okkampitiya Falls
description: Okkampitiya Falls, a breathtaking plunge into nature’s raw power, stands as a testament to Uva Province’s natural splendor. Surrounded by lush greenery, this majestic waterfall invites visitors to immerse themselves in its serene beauty, perfect for those seeking a tranquil escape.
monsoon_note: Peak flow Nov-Jan due to NE monsoon. Spectacular but risky.

name: Monaragala Town Falls
description: Monaragala Town Falls, a stunning multi-step waterfall located in the heart of Uva Province, offers visitors a breathtaking sight with its cascading waters and lush greenery. This picturesque spot is perfect for those seeking natural beauty and tranquility.
monsoon_note: High flow and dangerous during NE monsoon (Oct-Jan). Caution advised.

name: Wellawaya Gorge Falls
description: Discover the majestic Wellawaya Gorge Falls, a breathtaking natural spectacle where water cascades through a narrow gorge, carving its way through the rock formations. This iconic site offers a unique glimpse into the geological wonders of Uva Province, perfect for nature lovers and photographers alike.
monsoon_note: Dry season (Feb-May) best for hiking. Paths muddy in monsoon.

name: Bibile Stream Falls
description: Bibile Stream Falls, a breathtaking natural wonder in Monaragala, cascades down with vibrant colors and soothing sounds, offering visitors a serene escape into nature’s embrace.
monsoon_note: Roads may be impassable during heavy rain. 4WD recommended.

name: Sewanagala Falls
description: Discover the serene beauty of Sewanagala Falls, a majestic block formation where crystal-clear waters cascade down a picturesque valley, creating a natural spectacle that draws visitors year-round. Nestled in the heart of Monaragala, these falls offer a perfect blend of nature and tranquility.
monsoon_note: Peak flow Nov-Jan due to NE monsoon. Spectacular but risky.

name: Badalkumbura Stream Falls
description: Discover the serene beauty of Badalkumbura Stream Falls, where nature's splendor meets multi-step cascades. This picturesque spot offers a tranquil escape with its clear waters and lush surroundings, perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle.

name: Angunakolapelessa Stream Falls
description: Angunakolapelessa Stream Falls, a stunning natural wonder in Monaragala, Uva Province, features cascading water that creates a picturesque scene. This unique stream falls offer a serene spot for nature lovers and photographers alike, surrounded by lush greenery and vibrant wildlife.
